import numpy as np
import os

# Paths
msd_path = 'msd.dat'

# Load data: columns are x, y, z MSD components (since we used vector mode)
# Each line corresponds to a sample (every 1000 steps)
# Time can be inferred: each sample corresponds to 1000 steps * timestep (0.001 ps) = 1 ps per line

data = np.loadtxt(msd_path)
if data.ndim == 1:
    data = data.reshape(1, -1)
# total MSD = sum of components
msd_total = data.sum(axis=1)
# time array in ps
num_samples = len(msd_total)
time = np.arange(num_samples) * 1.0  # 1 ps per sample

# Determine start index after heating (first 1000 samples correspond to heating)
start = 1000  # after heating phase
# Use last part for linear fit (e.g., last 400 samples)
fit_start = start
fit_end = num_samples  # use all equilibration data

# Linear regression
coeffs = np.polyfit(time[fit_start:fit_end], msd_total[fit_start:fit_end], 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Å^2 per ps
# Diffusion coefficient D = slope / 6 (3D)
D_ang2_per_ps = slope / 6.0
# Convert to m^2/s: 1 Å^2/ps = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_per_s = D_ang2_per_ps * 1e-8
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (m^2/s): {D_m2_per_s:.3e}")
